introHtml: Custom padded seat cushions add comfort and brand visibility to any seating situation. Whether you are outfitting a company picnic, a stadium suite, or an ergonomic office, the extra padding makes long events easier on your guests. Choose from options like the Stadium Seat or Stadium Chair, and decorate with screen printing or embroidery. These cushions are a practical giveaway that recipients actually use and appreciate.
